cells.name: permission-ask
cells.detail: C176 preserves the existing compiler gate membership. Refused rather than merely unwired: a headless opencode run auto-rejects an ask verdict and auto-allows it under --auto/--yolo, so its own policy cannot pause the iterion run.

cells.name: permission-deny
cells.detail: C176 preserves the existing compiler gate membership. Refused rather than merely unwired: the OPENCODE_PERMISSION deny holds alone but fails OPEN under four measured configurations, each one silent: three operator ones (an agent-level permission, a permission key placed after *, a default_agent) and an invalid policy string. Membership stays unearned until a live denial and the config-ownership refusal land together.
